dungeon.ball_machine.intro: There's a machine with a picture of a round ball on it. The front says 255. It also has three buttons.
dungeon.ball_machine.prompt: Choose the button you want to push.
dungeon.ball_machine.display: The number {count} appeared on the screen.

dungeon.memory_road: Beyond this point lies the Road of Memories.
dungeon.door_hint: In this game, when you open or close a door, the position changes depending on your direction. Your direction means the direction you last moved in, or the direction you last bumped into something.
dungeon.weapon_gate: Those who go forward, sheathe your weapons. All others, draw your weapons.
dungeon.warp_back: {player}: Hey! How far back are you gonna send me?!
